identification: Oil still life of pink and white blossom in a green glazed jug on dark ground, cream distressed frame with mount, postcard-style card attached. Style is consistent with Edith Holmes (1893-1973, Tasmanian) but no signature visible; attribution unconfirmed.

viewing_check: Look for a signature (likely lower left or right, 'E. Holmes' or 'Edith Holmes') on the canvas or board; read the attached postcard/card text (gallery or exhibition label); turn the frame over for labels, titles, exhibition stickers and inscriptions; check whether it is oil on board or canvas versus a print or reproduction (look for raised brushwork and any print dots).
